notes.title: Update Cymut X Mutrobo RPG.
notes.content:
- When your Cymut or Mutrobo dies, you don't lose it, just look for it in your collection.
- Design improvements.
- collection base changed.

notes.title: Updates to Cymut X Mutrobo RPG
notes.content:
Hello,
I made some updates to Cymut X Mutrobo RPG:

- Capture system is now unique, no longer need to capture parts.

- The old capture menu, now it's just information about Cymuts and Mutrobos.

- Some adjustments to spell damage.

We will continue to do our best for Cymut X Mutrobo RPG.
Thank you very much.
